note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect and until is derived by hand from the 47-wire topology and the p.25 rule, not printed. ER-35 is prose only, so wires = as_printed. Topology: pushbutton 6 (6Y on 6+, 6X/6C) feeds 6C; relay 6 latches through 6H(+)-6G-6C-lamp-6E-coil-6F(-), lights light 1 (1A/6G) and runs the motor through 6L(+)-6K-D17 with D18 on M- and the wiper D16 on M+. Light k hangs on relay (7-k)'s C node (6G-1A, 5G-2A, 4G-3A, 3G-4A, 2G-5A, 1G-6A). Relay 5 pulls in whenever the wiper is on D15 (5C/D15); relay m (m = 4..1) pulls in only with the wiper on D(10+m) and relay m+1 in (nL/D, nK to the lower C node); every relay holds from + through the 1H-2H-3H-4H-5H arm chain and 6H. Pushbutton 5 (5Y on M-, 5X/6E) shorts relay 6's coil, so relay 6 drops, light 1 goes dark and the motor loses drive, while relays 1-5 and lights 2-6 hold until power is cycled. Script: run 1 as printed to light 6 and the pushbutton 5 stop; ER-35 re-set; run 2 stopped after light 3; then a derived re-set with the wiper set by hand on D15 (Step 7 notes F2/F5), where light 2 and relay 5 come on at power on before pushbutton 6. Script choices, not printed: the 200 ms pushbutton 6 hold after light 1, the 200 ms wait after light 6, the 500 ms pushbutton 5 hold, the stop after light 3, and the dial grab. Assumptions: the run-2 reset is clean only if run 1's stop leaves the wiper short of D15 (four pads past D11); the run-2 stop check rests on D17 + / D18 - turning toward increasing numbers (O-R11) and on the motor coasting less than 15 pads.
